The only containment check compares canonical paths using canonicalDestPath.startsWith(canonicalDirPath), but it does not ensure that the next character after canonicalDirPath is a path separator or end-of-string. An entryName resolving to a sibling directory such as /tmp/out2/file when the destination directory is /tmp/out passes this startsWith check and allows writing outside the intended destination directory."}]}
